column1: # SN 2011fe -- Type Ia supernova in M101 (d = 6.4 Mpc)
# Bolometric lightcurve from Pereira et al. 2013
# Original units 10^42 erg/s converted to L_sun (1 L_sun = 3.828e33 erg/s)
# Arnett parameters from Pereira et al. 2013 (Table 3):
#   tau_r (bolometric rise time) = 16.58 +/- 0.14 d  =>  t_m ~ 16.6 d
#   M_Ni    = 0.44 +/- 0.08 M_sun  (alpha = 1.2; Arnett rule gives ~0.53 M_sun)
# NOTE: The first 4 points (days < 5) are excluded. In Type Ia SNe the outermost
# thin layer of 56Ni heats the surface before the diffusion wave has propagated
# through the ejecta (the "dark phase" / early-excess effect; Kasen 2010
# Piro & Morozova 2016). The one-zone Arnett model assumes fully mixed ejecta
# and cannot reproduce this early emission -- including those points would bias
# the fit toward an artificially short diffusion time.
